description: Unités homogènes de végétation du domaine public fluvial régional de Bretagne is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. La cartographie des unités homogènes de végétations s’inscrit dans le cadre des différents plans d’actions en faveur de la biodiversité des Canaux de Bretagne. Inventaire, caractérisation et cartographie des Unités homogènes de végétation du domaine public fluvial (DPF) appartenant à la Région Bretagne. Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Environnement - Énergie. Its keywords are Bretagne, 233500016, données ouvertes, Voies navigables. The portal shows 5,840 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
